en.headline: Dinosaur fossil exhibition featuring Port Island finds opens free at Kowloon Park
en.dek: The show at the Hong Kong Heritage Discovery Centre runs until 12 May next year and includes a touchable femur plus 34 first-class protected fossils from the mainland.
body: Hong Kong's first dinosaur fossils, discovered on Port Island, go on public display from today at the Hong Kong Heritage Discovery Centre in Kowloon Park.

The exhibition, titled Sighting Dragons in the Field, is organised by the Development Bureau and the Institute of Vertebrate Paleontology and Paleoanthropology of the Chinese Academy of Sciences. It runs until 12 May 2027 and is free. It presents 66 sets of specimens, including all the skeletal fossils recovered from Port Island, which experts believe come from a single titanosauriform sauropod more than 20 metres long. Another 46 sets come from mainland China, of which 34 are first-class nationally protected paleontological fossils, most shown in Hong Kong for the first time.

Visitors can touch a fragment of a giant femur. Opening hours are 10am to 6pm on Mondays to Wednesdays and Fridays, and 10am to 7pm on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays. The centre is closed on Thursdays except public holidays. Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said at Thursday's opening ceremony that the show brings the city's ancient ecology into public view.

zh.headline: 赤洲恐龍化石展今起九龍公園免費開放 可觸摸巨型股骨
zh.dek: 香港文物探知館「見龍在田」展覽展至明年5月12日，展出港產化石及34組國家一級保護內地標本。
body: 本港赤洲首次發現的恐龍化石，由今天起在九龍公園香港文物探知館公開展出。
展覽名為「見龍在田：赤洲與中國內地恐龍化石展」，由發展局與中國科學院古脊椎動物與古人類研究所合辦，展期至2027年5月12日，免費入場。展品共66組，包括赤洲出土的全部骨骼化石，專家認為來自同一隻身長逾20米的泰坦巨龍形類蜃腳類恐龍。另有46組來自內地，當中34組為國家一級重點保護古生物化石，大部分屬首次在港展出。
參觀者可觸摸一塊巨型股骨碎片。開放時間為周一至周三及周五上午10時至下午6時，周六、日及公眾假期上午10時至晚上7時。逢周四（公眾假期除外）休館。發展局局長甫漢豪在周四開幕禮上表示，展覽將本港遠古生態面貌呈現公眾眼前。
